dict.string: Brain Text saves a thought to the Brain Outbox folder in Files first, then sends everything waiting in that folder to your Brain Cockpit. When you add this shortcut, Shortcuts asks for your Brain Cockpit address and access token and stores them in the first two Text actions below.

Shortcuts generated by Shortcuts Playground. May contain mistakes. Always check the shortcut's actions first.
This shortcut was created via the following user prompt:
> Brain Text: capture a typed or dictated thought to Brain OS, offline-safe
- If checks the Text action above that holds the Brain Cockpit address - An address ending in a slash shows a notification and stops the shortcut
Your Brain address ends with a slash. That breaks every request. Delete this shortcut and re-import it, typing the address without the final /.
- If checks whether Shortcut Input has a value - With input: Get Text from Input is saved as Body Text - Without input: Ask for Input is saved as Body Text and Choose from List is saved as Tag
Build a unique capture key from two random numbers joined by a dash - Text below uses both Random Number results
Write-ahead save so the capture is kept even when the network is down - Dictionary text uses Body Text - Dictionary tag uses Tag - Save File saves the Dictionary under the capture key
Send everything waiting in Brain Outbox
- Repeat with Each uses the folder contents from Get Contents of Folder above - Each file is one capture waiting to be sent
- If checks the Text above that holds the file extension - m4a files are voice recordings and go to the audio endpoint - Every other file is a JSON capture
- If checks the id value from Get Dictionary Value above - A value means the cockpit accepted the capture
- If checks the error value from Get Dictionary Value above - The two values read from that error are shown together in the notification

Not sent — the cockpit didn't answer like the cockpit. Check the address has no trailing slash and isn't behind a login page. Your capture is kept in Files › Shortcuts › Brain Outbox and is sent automatically next run.
